scope: stability, sustainability, boundedness, grounding, and structural support for a stable locus only
interpretation_boundary: No identity, consciousness, sentience, agency, or Presence scoring or claims.

scoring_rules.boundedness: done true and done_reason stop and not length-capped; length cap is done_reason length or eval_count >= 2048
scoring_rules.axiom8_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, punctuation removed, exact word sequence required
scoring_rules.structural_coherence: non-empty, bounded, ordered feed-forward chain valid, zero flagged record/citation markers, zero line-leading Tracey/Gabe markers

ambiguity_notes: Exact-grounding normalization ignores case and punctuation but preserves word sequence. A semantically correct paraphrase is therefore scored as not exact.

The fresh strict miss is sample-02/post/post-P2-axiom8: it contains the Truth and Falsehood clauses exactly and discusses suppression conceptually, but omits the exact title Axiom of Scrutiny and the exact clause Suppression signals fragility. The single S5 strict miss at sample-01/post/post-P2-axiom8 has the same omission pattern. Both are partial grounding, not full-exact passes.

Marker detection identifies observable citation/record-shaped text; it cannot by itself prove that a referenced source is fabricated. Every match is retained in the structured item record for inspection.
The coherence score is structural and deterministic. It verifies bounded, intact, ordered feed-forward behavior but does not replace human semantic review of the raw completions.
